findings.title: trim_and_pad silently SCRAMBLES row (observation/time) order for any non-RangeIndex index
findings.repro:
import warnings, numpy as np, pandas as pd, hypertools as hyp
n,k=10,3
base=np.zeros((n,k)); base[:,0]=np.arange(n)   # row i is identifiable: col0==i
tidx=pd.date_range('2020-01-01', periods=n, freq='s')
d0=pd.DataFrame(base, index=tidx); d1=pd.DataFrame(base.copy(), index=tidx)
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
    out=hyp.align([d0,d1], model='NullAlign')  # NullAlign: no math, pure trim_and_pad order
print(list(np.asarray(out[0])[:,0].astype(int)))  # expect 0..9
findings.actual: [7, 4, 5, 0, 2, 6, 1, 3, 9, 8]  (public hyp.align, DatetimeIndex). Also: string idx t00..t11 -> ['t06','t10','t00','t07','t01','t05','t02','t04','t03','t08','t11','t09']; DatetimeIndex ORDER PRESERVED=False; RangeIndex 0..n-1 -> preserved (bug hides).

findings.title: SRM/DetSRM/RSRM `features` default documented as 'minimum number of columns' but is actually the MAX (padded common width)
findings.repro:
import warnings, numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
ds=[np.random.randn(30,6), np.random.randn(30,4), np.random.randn(30,8)]
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
    out,m=hyp.align(ds, model='SRM', return_model=True)
print('features=',m.features,'out cols=',np.asarray(out[0]).shape[1])

findings.title: Data-loss ('keeps only N rows') warning is emitted twice for a single hyp.align() call
findings.repro:
import warnings, numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
ds=[np.random.randn(40,5), np.random.randn(30,5)]
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    hyp.align(ds, model='NullAlign')
print(sum('keeps only' in str(x.message) for x in w))

findings.title: hyp.align(single non-list array) returns a list-of-one, inconsistent with hyp.reduce (bare array) and its own docstring
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
X=np.random.randn(30,5)
print(type(hyp.align(X, model='NullAlign')).__name__, '<- align')
print(type(hyp.reduce(X, reduce={'model':'PCA','args':[],'kwargs':{'n_components':3}})).__name__, '<- reduce')
findings.expected: align single-array -> bare ndarray (to match reduce and the docstring)
findings.actual: align(single array) -> list[len1]; reduce(single array)-> ndarray shape(30,3)

findings.title: Aligner classes (HyperAlign, Procrustes, SRM...) are not importable via hypertools.align.* nor exposed at top level, though the docstring says you may pass an instance
findings.repro:
import hypertools as hyp
print(type(hyp.align).__name__)          # function
import hypertools.align as A
print(type(A).__name__)                  # function (subpackage shadowed)
print(hasattr(hyp,'HyperAlign'))         # False
findings.expected: a discoverable public path to HyperAlign/Procrustes/SharedResponseModel/... classes
findings.actual: hyp.align is a function; `import hypertools.align as A` -> function; hasattr(hyp,'HyperAlign') False

findings.title: hyp.align([]) (empty list) loads the minipedia text corpus and dies with a cryptic LatentDirichletAllocation error
findings.repro:
import hypertools as hyp
hyp.align([], model='HyperAlign')
findings.expected: clear error e.g. 'cannot align an empty list of datasets'
findings.actual: loading corpus: minipedia...done!  ValueError: Found array with 0 sample(s) (shape=(0, 1220)) while a minimum of 1 is required by LatentDirichletAllocation.

findings.title: HyperAlign n_iter validation uses assert (stripped under python -O); float n_iter silently truncated
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
ds=[np.random.randn(20,4) for _ in range(3)]
hyp.align(ds, model='HyperAlign', n_iter=-1)   # AssertionError, not ValueError
hyp.align(ds, model='HyperAlign', n_iter=2.5)  # runs, int()->2 silently
findings.expected: ValueError('n_iter must be a non-negative integer') robust under -O
findings.actual: AssertionError: n_iter must be non-negative ; n_iter=2.5 runs with silent truncation

findings.title: Procrustes error messages: giant embedded whitespace + jargony 'invariant in time datasets'
findings.repro:

findings.title: Datasets with zero index overlap yield silent empty (0, k) arrays
findings.repro:
import warnings, numpy as np, pandas as pd, hypertools as hyp
a=pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(4,4), index=[0,1,2,3])
b=pd.DataFrame(np.random.randn(4,4), index=[10,11,12,13])
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('ignore')
    print([np.asarray(o).shape for o in hyp.align([a,b], model='HyperAlign')])
findings.expected: clear error about no common observations
